feature: Follow the dollar connected visual story

design.approach: A persistent illustrated economic-contribution scene progresses through demand, direct industry, suppliers, optional induced household spending and geographic allocation. Native scrolling and explicit chapter controls share normalized URL state. A compact landscape layout and reduced-motion states preserve the same values.
design.dataMeaning: Official input-output multipliers estimate economic contributions, not traced payments. Rest of Canada remains aggregate; labour income overlaps GDP; jobs are positions supported.
design.implementation: React owns scenario and chapter state. One SVG/HTML scene uses CSS transitions, requestAnimationFrame-throttled native scroll observation and existing province geometry. No added dependency, inference call or generated data.
design.referenceTransformation: Original industry/supplier/household line illustrations and provincial geography replace the reference payment-card objects. No reference assets or text copied.
